rows.note: Use 教 as the all-purpose verb for passing on knowledge, including a threatening 教你... meaning “I’ll teach you a lesson.”

example.english: I’ll teach you how to cook this dish.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaau3 nei5 dim2 joeng2 zyu2 ni1 mei6 sung3

rows.note: Use 教書 when emphasizing teaching as someone’s job or teaching at a school or university.

example.english: I teach at a secondary school.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 zung1 hok6 gaau3 syu1

rows.note: Use 教訓 when explicitly saying that someone will be taught a lesson through unpleasant consequences.

example.english: If you cause trouble again, I’ll teach you a lesson.
example.jyutping: nei5 zoi3 gaau2 si6 ngo5 zau6 gaau3 fan3 nei5
